characters.summary: Jyn Erso is a skilled rebel soldier, brawler, and survivor who utilizes improvised firearms, explosives, and melee combat. She relies on agility and guerrilla tactics rather than formal military training.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to conventional physical damage and blaster fire as an unenhanced human
limitations: Human physical limitations and standard stamina

sources.supports: Overview of Jyn Erso's role, weapons, and combat feats in Rogue One.

feats.claim: Fought off multiple stormtroopers in hand-to-hand combat and using captured blasters.
feats.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

notableResults.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
notableResults.note: Engaged in guerrilla skirmishes during the Battle of Scarif.

campaignTags.claim: Infiltrated the Imperial citadel on Scarif using forged credentials and disguise.

unknowns: Exact proficiency with heavy Imperial weaponry outside of standard rifles.

characters.summary: K-2SO is a reprogrammed Imperial KX-series security droid possessing exceptional physical strength and tactical calculation. He excels at subduing multiple armed opponents simultaneously through brute force and precision.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy ordinance and targeted structural destruction
limitations: Cannot regenerate damaged mechanical components without workshop tools

sources.supports: Details on K-2SO's physical strength, droid chassis, and abilities.

feats.claim: Tore open a locked security door and defeated multiple stormtroopers barehanded.
feats.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

notableResults.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
notableResults.note: Secured corridors and held off waves of guards during the infiltration of the Scarif vault.

campaignTags.claim: K-2SO is an Imperial security droid.
Capable of interfacing with and slicing Imperial computer systems.

unknowns: Full extent of his programming restrictions before being wiped by Cassian Andor.

characters.summary: Kanan Jarrus is a Jedi Knight who survived Order 66, combining traditional lightsaber forms with the Force. Despite losing his sight, he developed heightened Force perception to continue fighting effectively.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized anti-Jedi tactics and overwhelming physical attacks
limitations: Physical blindness requires total reliance on the Force for spatial awareness

sources.supports: Kanan Jarrus's role as a Jedi and combat capabilities in Star Wars Rebels.

feats.claim: Fought and defeated Imperial Inquisitors in lightsaber combat.

notableResults.note: Won a prolonged lightsaber duel after tapping deeper into the Force.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes Force levitation and jump enhancement.
Pilots the Ghost starship.

unknowns: The upper limits of his telekinetic strength under extreme duress.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)
characters.summary: Kit Fisto was a Nautolan Jedi Master known for his mastery of Form I (Shii-Cho), an infectious smile, and high adaptability in aquatic environments due to his biology.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to exceptional mastery of dark side combat forms by top-tier Sith Lords
limitations: Requires access to water or specialized gear if operating indefinitely outside suitable atmospheres, though standard atmosphere is fine.

sources.supports: General background and combat role of Jedi Master Kit Fisto.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with General Grievous and cut off several of his hands.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Defeated swiftly alongside other Jedi Masters during the arrest attempt.

campaignTags.claim: Nautolan biology grants natural proficiency in water environments.
Capable of breathing underwater indefinitely via head-tentacles.

unknowns: Full extent of his powers outside standard Jedi training regimens.

characters.summary: Kuiil was an Ugnaught moisture farmer and mechanic who utilized practical trade skills, machinery repair, and blaster self-defense. He was resourceful and adept at reconditioning droids.
weaknesses: Elderly Ugnaught with standard biological vulnerability to weapons and injury
limitations: Advanced age limits strenuous physical endurance

sources.supports: Background on Kuiil, his trade skills, and role in The Mandalorian.

feats.claim: Successfully reprogrammed IG-11 from a bounty hunter into a nurse and protector droid.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed while protecting the Child.

campaignTags.claim: Expert mechanic capable of completely rebuilding and reprogramming an IG-series assassin droid.
Expert at taming and riding Blurrg mounts across Arvala-7.

unknowns: Combat capabilities beyond basic self-defense rifle shooting.

characters.summary: Kylo Ren is a powerful dark side warrior wielding an unstable crossguard lightsaber and utilizing devastating telekinetic and mind-probing abilities. He relies on raw, aggressive emotion in combat.

mechanisms: Pain tolerance fueled by dark side rage

weaknesses: Emotional instability and inner conflict weaken his dark side resolve
limitations: Prone to reckless aggression when provoked

sources.supports: Kylo Ren's abilities, lightsaber, and Force powers in the Sequel Trilogy.

feats.claim: Frosted a live blaster bolt mid-air and held it suspended indefinitely.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker
notableResults.note: Fatally exhausted during their duel on the wreckage of the Death Star II.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes Force-enhanced leaps and bounds.
Extracts memories and paralyzes targets using the Force.
Pilots his customized TIE silencer.

unknowns: Full potential if he had fully committed to the dark side without internal division.

characters.summary: Lando Calrissian is a charismatic smuggler, gambler, and pilot who relies on blaster pistols, cunning diplomacy, and tactical escapes rather than direct military force.
weaknesses: Standard human physical capabilities with no supernatural defenses
limitations: Relies heavily on having access to a ship, allies, or an escape route

sources.supports: Overview of Lando Calrissian's history, piloting skills, and role across Star Wars films.

characters.summary: Leia Organa is a rebel leader, politician, and trained Jedi who combines tactical command experience with blaster proficiency and latent Force abilities.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical injury and standard weaponry
limitations: Formal Jedi training was cut short, limiting active combat applications of the Force compared to masters

sources.supports: Leia Organa's combat history, leadership, and Force capabilities.

characters.summary: Luke Skywalker is a legendary Jedi Master who combines master-level lightsaber proficiency with immense telekinetic and empathetic Force powers, capable of turning the tide of galactic conflicts.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to intense dark side corruption if tempted or overwhelmed emotionally
limitations: Human physical endurance can be strained by prolonged, intense combat

sources.supports: Luke Skywalker's Jedi abilities, lightsaber combat, and feats in the Original Trilogy.

feats.claim: Destroyed the first Death Star by using the Force to guide a proton torpedo into an unshielded thermal exhaust port.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
notableResults.note: Overpowered Darth Vader in a fit of rage aboard the second Death Star before sparing him.

campaignTags.claim: Performs extraordinary jumps using Force augmentation.
Uses Jedi mind tricks to influence sentient minds.
Expert ace pilot of X-wing starfighters.
Communicates telepathically with family and peers.

unknowns: The absolute ceiling of his raw Force potential during his prime years.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Legends (Dark Empire comic series)
characters.summary: Dark Empire Luke is a formidable iteration of Luke Skywalker who temporarily fell to the dark side under Emperor Palpatine, wielding devastating dark side force techniques including Force lightning.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological appeals to his former light side nature by loved ones
characters.formDifferences: Embarks on a dark side path, gaining access to offensive Force lightning and heightened aggressive combat prowess compared to his standard Jedi Knight incarnation.

sources.supports: Details on Luke Skywalker's fall to the dark side and acquisition of dark side powers in Dark Empire.

notableResults.note: Fought Leia until she appealed to his inner light, prompting his turnaround.

unknowns: Whether he could maintain complete stability while wielding Palpatine's teachings indefinitely.
